_meta.title: DisInforMeter short module — multilingual item matrix
_meta.note: Translations are the translator-confirmed wording fielded in S4. english_deployed is the exact S4 wording the translations correspond to; english_harmonised is the harmonised analysis wording used in the scale-development paper and policy-report supplement.
